formulas.ascii: Among reference rows J strictly within squared tolerance t^2 of p, choose the lexicographic minimum (squared distance, reference row). Output that reference position, or retain p and report NO_REFERENCE when no candidate exists. J is the whole reference set or the matching feature range; t=max(parameters[0],0).

snapshots.name: areas
snapshots.meaning: community-area boundaries, whose vertices are the snap references

snapshots.name: referenceRows
snapshots.meaning: row of the community-area vertex the park vertex moved to; 0xffffffff when it stayed

snapshots.name: snappedParks
snapshots.meaning: park vertices after snapping to area vertices closer than 50 m
